company: German Green Steel and Power Limited
about: German Green Steel and Power is a vertically integrated iron and steel maker in Gujarat, selling mainly 'German TMT' TMT bars, plus MS billets and sponge iron. It runs two plants (Samakhiyali and Viramgam) with a 20 MW captive power plant and wind-solar capacity. Revenue was about ₹1,679 crore in FY26, with 97.74% of sales in Gujarat.
sector: Steel (TMT bars, MS billets, sponge iron)

objects.purpose: Capex for expansion of Samakhiyali (Kutch) facility and hybrid wind-solar power plant

promoters.background: Iraki family; Inamulhaq and Abdulhaq have 36 and 31 years in iron and steel; family in the business since 1976. Promoters and family have given personal guarantees for company borrowings.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers 50.62% of FY26 revenue; largest customer 10.67%; 97.74% of FY26 sales in Gujarat.

litigation_note: Legal proceedings pending against the company, promoters, subsidiaries and directors; income-tax disputes under appeal of ₹112.65 crore; contingent liabilities and commitments total ₹168.04 crore (FY26); cease-and-desist trademark notice from H&K Rolling Mill Engineers (May 2025).
strengths: Vertically integrated plant making sponge iron, MS billets and TMT bars in-house, with 20 MW captive power plus wind-solar.
About 75.44% of energy needs met by own captive and renewable plants (FY26).
Revenue grew 21.91% CAGR FY24-FY26 and EBITDA margin rose from 7.02% to 9.94%.
Strong 'German TMT' brand and wide dealer/distributor network in Gujarat; 4-5 star green steel ratings.
High capacity utilisation (sponge iron 95%, TMT 88% in FY26); expansion planned to roughly double capacity.
Samakhiyali plant is close to Mundra (105 km) and Kandla (50 km) ports.
Debt/equity improved from 1.18 to 0.79 and ROCE is 19.31% in FY26.
Contract manufacturing agreement with JSW One Distribution for TMT bars.

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers gave 50.62% of FY26 revenue; the largest alone gave 10.67%. Business runs on purchase orders without long-term contracts.

risks.title: Heavy debt
risks.detail: Borrowings were ₹344.13 crore at August 31, 2026 (₹334.37 crore at March 2026); finance costs were ₹42.96 crore in FY26.

risks.title: Heavy Gujarat dependence
risks.detail: Both plants are in Gujarat and 97.74% of FY26 sales are made there, so regional disruption or demand slump hits the whole business.

risks.title: Related-party dealings
risks.detail: Large transactions with promoter-linked entities, including loans and sales of goods (e.g. 3.57% of FY25 revenue to Iraki Enterprise), plus leased premises and a licensed (not owned) 'German TMT' trademark.

risks.title: Volatile prices and raw material supply
risks.detail: Prices of TMT bars, billets and sponge iron are cyclical; scrap, iron ore and coal are bought from third parties on purchase orders. EBITDA margin is thin at 9.94%.

risks.title: Unplaced capex orders and execution risk
risks.detail: ₹226.33 crore of IPO money goes to expansion and orders for some equipment are not yet placed; delays could hurt returns. About 28% of project cost is already spent.

risks.title: Tax and contingent liabilities, litigation
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities and commitments total ₹168.04 crore, including ₹112.65 crore of income-tax disputes; auditors flagged emphasis of matters for FY25 and FY24.

risks.title: Low operating cash flow versus capex and promoter guarantees
risks.detail: Capex of ₹133-246 crore a year outran operating cash flow of ₹28-141 crore; borrowings carry promoter personal guarantees and inventory days are rising.

notes: Restated Consolidated, FY24-FY26, converted from lakhs to ₹ crore. PAT is restated profit for the year; net worth is total equity incl. NCI (₹2.15 crore in FY26); reserves is other equity. Cash_and_bank is cash plus other bank balances (garbled balance sheet, assignment of bank balances row is moderate confidence). Current ratio computed from current assets/current liabilities. ROE not separately reported (RoNW used). Peer revenue_cr is total income. Promoter post-offer holding computed as (4,42,86,400 - 10,00,000 OFS)/7,53,49,197. Pre-IPO placement of 18,38,000 shares at ₹270 in Sep 2025 reduced fresh issue to ₹290 crore. P/E 9.32 at cap price ₹139 on FY26 EPS. No employee reservation. No stub period.
